description: Per-case mapping of the anonymized historical incident corpus (bound to the frozen source snapshot) to the current public product contract. Two separately numbered lineages; equal numeric suffixes are not the same incident. Superseded rows carry successor attribution; active rows carry the current invariant, synthetic trigger, positive and negative assertions, executed locators, platform-split results and the verdict. DSH rows are analogue_only: shared semantics verified on the Codex side, never a DSH fix claim. Pending rows keep their missing native evidence explicit.
